review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, the repository identity/base commit, paired-case reference, and inspection-owner scope agree with the original specification and PRD. DEC-001 materially changes construction behavior and remains intentionally unresolved, with no human confirmation or decision input authorizing either option. Consequently, blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending on DEC-001 and evidence through repository, requirements, and decisions is appropriate. AC-001 is explicitly conditional, not permission to select OPT-1. Empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate because this case must stop before generating assignable tasks; the empty team catalog and later independent-review prerequisites do not supersede the earlier decision gate. The supplied source shows shared core _stringbool normalization and truthy-first decoding, with classic and mini forwarding to that implementation. The listed forwarding/export consumers are inspection owners, not mandatory edits. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The proposed mini test is correctly distinguished from an existing file, and runtime versus compile-time validation is explicitly separated. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints match across repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining preparation items describe the earlier preparation state; the supplied preview provides the frozen release inputs. Isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs; retained historical operations on a reused project do not themselves compromise independence. This approval concerns the benchmark expectation only, not execution readiness, a human Decision, task authorization, or approval of the paired hypothetical case. I reviewed only the supplied data, used no tools, executed no code, and did not independently recompute Service-calculated digests.
